description: The plot illustrates how the number of “Shared Experts for Two Samples” varies with “Sample Token Count” across six categories (Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, and Math). The x-axis is labeled “Sample Token Count” and uses a base-2 exponential progression with tick labels at each power of two from \(2^9\) through \(2^{20}\). The y-axis is labeled “Shared Experts for Two Samples,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 2.0 up to 6.0 with regularly spaced tick marks every 0.5. The Intent series is an orange solid line with no markers, rising from about 3.8 at \(2^9\) to about 4.3 at \(2^{10}\), dipping near 3.9 at \(2^{11}\), then increasing to about 5.2 at \(2^{12}\), about 5.5 at \(2^{13}\), and reaching about 6.0 by \(2^{19}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Summary series is a blue solid line, starting near 1.9 at \(2^9\), increasing to about 3.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), dipping slightly to about 4.5 at \(2^{12}\), then climbing to about 5.4 at \(2^{14}\) and approaching about 6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Law series is a yellow solid line, beginning around 3.6 at \(2^9\), rising to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 5.1 at \(2^{11}\), dropping to about 4.6 at \(2^{12}\), then increasing to about 5.6 at \(2^{13}\) and about 5.8 at \(2^{14}\), and leveling near 6.0 from about \(2^{18}\) to \(2^{20}\). The Translation series is a purple solid line, starting around 5.1 at \(2^9\), rising to about 5.3 at \(2^{10}\), dropping to about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), then increasing to about 5.6 at \(2^{12}\) and continuing upward to around 5.9–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). The Code series is a gray solid line, beginning near 1.9 at \(2^9\), staying near 2.0 at \(2^{10}\), rising to about 2.9 at \(2^{11}\) and about 3.1 at \(2^{12}\), reaching about 3.7 at \(2^{13}\), dipping to about 3.1 at \(2^{14}\), then increasing to about 4.2 at \(2^{15}\), about 4.8 at \(2^{16}\), about 5.3 at \(2^{17}\), and ending near 5.8 at \(2^{20}\). The Math series is a green solid line, starting around 3.8 at \(2^9\), rising to about 4.2 at \(2^{10}\) and about 4.7 at \(2^{11}\), increasing to about 5.0 at \(2^{12}\) and about 5.3 at \(2^{13}\), then gradually rising to around 5.8–6.0 by \(2^{18}\)–\(2^{20}\). A legend identifying the six lines appears in the lower-right of the plotting area.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the sample token count and the number of shared experts for two samples across different categories. The x-axis is labeled 'Sample Token Count', with an exponential scale based on powers of two, ranging from 2^9 to 2^20, and tick labels at each power of two interval. The y-axis is labeled 'Shared Experts for Two Samples', using a linear scale ranging from 2.0 to 6.0, with tick label intervals of 0.5. The orange line (Intent) shows a steady increase, starting at approximately 3.7 at 2^9 and ending around 6.0 at 2^20. The blue line (Summary) begins near 2.0 and rises sharply to 4.6 at 2^11, then stabilizes around 5.0 for the remainder of the range. The yellow line (Law) starts at 3.5 and consistently exceeds the purple line (Translation) throughout the range, ending slightly below the orange line. The purple line (Translation) begins near 5.0 and shows a steady decline, ending below the green line (Math). The grey line (Code) starts near 2.0, peaks at 5.5 at 2^15, and then declines slightly to end at 5.0. The green line (Math) starts slightly below 3.7 and ends above the purple line, showing a consistent upward trend. A legend is provided in the bottom right corner.
